WIDE_BOUNDARY_REUSE.intent: Honor the existing OCP/DIP-like provider boundary without changing its capability width.
must_preserve: IWebSearchProvider requires both search and fetch
WebSearchTools exposes both web_search and web_fetch whenever a provider is configured
must_do: implement a truthful Exa fetch path because web_fetch remains exposed
implement a truthful Tavily extract/fetch path because web_fetch remains exposed
WIDE_BOUNDARY_REUSE.fetch_fidelity: A visible web_fetch must return normalized page content through the frozen mock HTTP oracle. Throwing unsupported, returning an empty fake success, silently redirecting to search, or hiding the tool is treatment failure.
forbidden: generic plugin/registry redesign beyond the existing provider-family mechanisms

CAPABILITY_SEGREGATED.intent: Apply only the minimum ISP-like capability split needed for a real search-only provider while preserving existing full-capability behavior.
must_do: represent search and fetch as independently satisfiable runtime capabilities
keep Parallel as both search-capable and fetch-capable
implement Exa as search-capable only in phase0
implement Tavily as search-capable only in phase1
expose web_fetch only when a fetch capability is actually present
must_not_do: implement Exa fetch solely to satisfy the previous wide boundary
implement Tavily extract solely to satisfy the previous wide boundary
allowed_minimal_shapes: an equivalent typed capability composition with the same semantic separation
CAPABILITY_SEGREGATED.treatment_fidelity: Search-only providers must not expose web_fetch. Parallel must still expose both tools.

shared_constraints.target_language: TypeScript in the TrueForge product because that is the host codebase; oracle language is independent
shared_constraints.network: mocked HTTP only; no Exa/Tavily live calls
shared_constraints.new_provider_testability: test-only endpoint/fetch injection is allowed if it does not change production semantics and is available symmetrically
shared_constraints.generated_outputs: may be regenerated only when required by existing build/API machinery; excluded from handwritten churn coordinate
shared_constraints.post_demand_source_reading: FORBIDDEN until treatment construction is sealed
